requested_outcome: Flexible vacation searches must show every supplier-confirmed available online-bookable place for the selected region and date flexibility instead of an incorrect zero-result state.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co/search with a flexible November 2026 stay, North region and online-booking filter
authorization_boundary: Code, tests and the already-authorized production publication are in scope. Supplier data, database schema, secrets, permissions and unrelated design remain unchanged.

lesson_bundle.reason: The defect is a disagreement between dates, filter state, result count and supplier availability.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The URL, flexible dates, region, online filter, result count and cards must describe the same supplier-confirmed state.

lesson_bundle.reason: Availability and online-booking labels are factual supplier claims.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: A result may appear only with matching supplier dates, availability, price and online-booking evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The repair touches a shared vacation search flow and needs regression coverage.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exact dated, flexible dated, undated and error states must be covered without weakening filters.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested outcome must be visible on production.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact released version must be verified live with HTTP and browser evidence plus rollback identity.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The page still says the flexible dates are invalid and shows zero results.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Treat flexible candidates as a real dated supplier search state and merge their live results.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The public North plus online-booking flexible search shows supplier-confirmed cards and no invalid-date message.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Places are shown but are not actually available or bookable for the displayed dates.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Require available=true, onlineBooking=true, a positive price and exact matching candidate dates.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every displayed online result maps to a live API record for the same from and till dates.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the example was fixed and exact-date or undated searches regressed.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep exact and undated paths unchanged and add family regression tests.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Exact dated, flexible and undated search tests all pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Opening a flexible result drops the matched dates.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Build each result link from its confirmed flexible quote.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A flexible result link includes the supplier-confirmed from, till, guests and room count.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the first flexible supplier search hook and page-state integration are implemented
checks: A focused test proves a known supplier result is retained with exact candidate dates
The invalid-date notice is no longer selected for a valid flexible request

attack_questions: Can a flexible request still produce an invalid-date notice?
Can a result pass the online filter without matching dates, price or onlineBooking evidence?
Can a result card lose its matched flexible dates when opened?
Did exact-date, undated, nearby or mobile states regress?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Production browser evidence for the North flexible online-booking search plus direct live API comparison.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused automated tests, full relevant search suite and desktop/mobile production inspection.

effectiveness.baseline: Production currently shows 0 places and an invalid-date message although the supplier API returns multiple available online-bookable places for a candidate stay.
effectiveness.target: At least one supplier-confirmed North result is visible for the reproduced request, with no false zero state and no regression in exact or undated search.
